title: Life Inside the Walls
summary: Humanity lives behind three concentric Walls, hunted by man-eating Titans outside them.

title: The World Beyond the Walls
summary: The Survey Corps reach the ocean and learn that the world extends far beyond the Walls.
because: What the Scouts find beyond the Walls overturns what humanity believed about its world.

title: Liberio Internment Zone
summary: Eldians live confined to an internment zone in the Marleyan city of Liberio.

title: Warrior Candidates
summary: Child candidates compete to inherit the Armored Titan.
because: Eldian children can win honorary status for their families by becoming Warriors.

title: Declaration of War
summary: Eren attacks the Marleyan festival in Liberio and declares war on the world.
why_it_matters: The speech unites global nations against Paradis while providing Eren the precise international target and justification to strike.
because: Eren aims to strike Marley before it can strike Paradis.

title: Fall of Shiganshina
summary: Colossal and plated Titans breach Wall Maria, allowing wandering Titans to invade Shiganshina and force humanity behind Wall Rose.
why_it_matters: It triggers the fall of Wall Maria, the death of Carla Yeager, and Eren's vow to eradicate all Titans.

title: Battle of Trost District
summary: The Colossal Titan breaches Trost District's outer gate, prompting a desperate defense where Eren first transforms into a Titan to seal the breach.
why_it_matters: It marks humanity's first military victory against the Titans and reveals Eren's Titan-shifting ability to the military.

title: Eren Joins the Scout Regiment
summary: Following a contentious military tribunal, Premier Zachary places Eren under Commander Erwin and Captain Levi's custody in the Scout Regiment.
why_it_matters: It secures Eren from execution by the Military Police and integrates his Titan power into the Scouts' offensive strategy.

title: Forest of Giant Trees Chase
summary: An intelligent Female Titan ambushes the 57th Expedition and relentlessly pursues Levi Squad through the Forest of Giant Trees.
why_it_matters: It exposes the existence of an intelligent infiltrator among human ranks and devastates the elite Special Operations Squad.

title: Battle of Stohess District
summary: The Scout Regiment executes a sting operation in Stohess District to expose and capture Annie Leonhart as the Female Titan.
why_it_matters: It unmasks the first enemy infiltrator within the walls and cracks Wall Rose to reveal colossal Titans encased inside.

title: Reiner and Bertholdt Reveal
summary: Reiner Braun casually confesses to Eren on Wall Rose that he is the Armored Titan and Bertholdt Hoover is the Colossal Titan.
why_it_matters: It unmasks two central comrades as the infiltrators who destroyed Wall Maria and precipitates Eren's abduction.

title: Royal Government Coup d'État
summary: Erwin Smith and Commander Pyxis orchestrate a military coup to overthrow the puppet king and crown Historia Reiss as the legitimate monarch.
why_it_matters: It purges the corrupt nobility, unlocks the secrets of the Founding Titan, and puts the entire military behind retaking Wall Maria.

title: Battle of Shiganshina District
summary: The Scout Regiment conducts an all-out assault in Shiganshina against the Beast, Armored, and Colossal Titans to reclaim Wall Maria.
why_it_matters: It results in the recapture of Wall Maria, the defeat of Bertholdt, and Erwin's sacrifice to save Armin with the Titan serum.

title: The Basement Reveal
summary: Eren and the surviving Scouts open Grisha Yeager's basement desk, uncovering journals and a photograph that prove human civilization thrives beyond the walls.
why_it_matters: It shatters the wall inhabitants' entire worldview by revealing the conflict between Eldia and Marley across the sea.

title: Marley Mid-East War
summary: Marley's military and Titan warriors capture Fort Slava to conclude their four-year war against the Mid-East Allied Forces.
why_it_matters: The battle proves that modern artillery threatens Titan supremacy, forcing Marley to aggressively resume its objective to take Paradis's Founding Titan.

title: Liberio Internment
summary: Eldian soldiers return to the walled Liberio Internment Zone under constant surveillance and systemic discrimination by Marley.
why_it_matters: It demonstrates the harsh oppression and psychological conditioning continental Eldians endure while desperate to attain honorary Marleyan citizenship.

title: Eren Infiltrates Marley
summary: Eren disguises himself as an injured soldier named Kruger in Liberio to gather intelligence and manipulate Falco.
why_it_matters: The covert operation allows Eren to position himself directly beneath the festival stage and coordinate the surprise attack with his allies.

title: Raid on Liberio
summary: Eren and the Survey Corps launch a devastating preemptive raid on Liberio, eliminating Marleyan military brass and seizing the War Hammer Titan.
why_it_matters: The victory secures the War Hammer Titan and extracts Zeke to Paradis, but Sasha's death fractures trust within the Survey Corps.

title: Eren Imprisoned
summary: Paradis military authorities arrest and detain Eren for insubordination following his unsanctioned assault on Marley.
why_it_matters: His detention sparks public unrest, alienates soldiers who revere him, and accelerates the formation of the extremist Yeagerist faction.

title: Yeagerist Coup
summary: Yeagerist insurgents assassinate Premier Zachary with a bomb, free Eren, and seize control of the military government.
why_it_matters: The violent takeover dismantles the chain of command and gives Eren complete authority over Paradis's strategic direction.

title: Contact Between Eren and Zeke
summary: Zeke makes physical contact with Eren's severed head in Shiganshina just before Eren dies, unlocking the Founding Titan.
why_it_matters: The physical connection transports the brothers into the mystical realm of the Paths to determine the fate of all Eldians.

title: Paths Sequence
summary: Zeke and Eren travel through Grisha's memories within the Paths, revealing how Eren influenced the timeline to acquire the Founder.
why_it_matters: It proves the Attack Titan can transmit memories across time, confirming that Eren deliberately guided his father to slaughter the Reiss family.

title: Rumbling Begins
summary: Eren frees Ymir Fritz from royal servitude, unhardens all walls on Paradis, and commands the Wall Titans to flatten the earth.
why_it_matters: The commencement of the Rumbling initiates global catastrophic destruction and forces all surviving factions to respond.

title: Global Alliance Forms
summary: Survey Corps veterans and Marleyan Warriors set aside their bitter history to forge a joint coalition to halt the Rumbling.
why_it_matters: The coalition combines the remaining Titan shifters and elite Scouts into the sole force capable of opposing Eren's global genocide.

title: Final Battle
summary: The allied coalition confronts Eren's Founding Titan at Fort Salta, resulting in Eren's death and the permanent end of the Titan curse.
why_it_matters: Eren's defeat ends the Rumbling, frees Ymir from her thousands of years of suffering, and eliminates the Power of the Titans forever.

title: Eren Yeager
summary: Passionate soldier driven to eliminate Titans and fight for Eldia's freedom.
bio: Born in Shiganshina, Eren joins the Scout Regiment after his mother is killed. Possessing the Attack and Founding Titans, he later leads the Yeagerists and triggers the Rumbling.

title: Mikasa Ackerman
summary: Top graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps fiercely devoted to protecting Eren.
bio: An elite soldier of the Scout Regiment with unmatched combat abilities. Bound to Eren by deep devotion, she ultimately plays a pivotal role in ending the Titan curse during the final battle.

title: Armin Arlert
summary: Childhood friend whose deductive mind compensates for a weak body.
bio: Eren and Mikasa's childhood friend who compensates for physical weakness with extraordinary deductive reasoning. He inherits the Colossal Titan and eventually becomes the 15th Scout Commander.

title: Reiner Braun
summary: Unusually strong cadet of the 104th whose confident manner hides something.
bio: An Eldian Warrior for Marley who breached Wall Maria with Bertholdt. Plagued by guilt and a split persona from his time in the 104th, he remains torn between duty and his former comrades.

title: Bertholdt Hoover
summary: Quiet Warrior who breached Wall Maria as the feared Colossal Titan.
bio: A reserved Marleyan Warrior who infiltrated the Walls alongside Reiner. Despite possessing the devastating Colossal Titan, he struggled with remorse before falling in the Battle of Shiganshina.

title: Annie Leonhart
summary: Skilled Marleyan Warrior operative who possessed the Female Titan.
bio: An aloof, expert martial artist who joined the Military Police to complete her infiltration mission. After being exposed as the Female Titan in Stohess, she encased herself in crystal.

title: Levi Ackerman
summary: Captain of the Special Operations Squad, famed as humanity's strongest.
bio: A formidable, clean-obsessed soldier from the Underground who rose to lead the Scouts' elite squad. His Ackerman bloodline and unmatched speed make him the greatest threat to Titans.

title: Hange Zoë
summary: Eccentric Scout scientist who studies Titans far too closely.
bio: An energetic researcher obsessed with Titan biology who invents anti-Titan weaponry. Succeeding Erwin as 14th Commander, Hange leads the Scouts through political turmoil and the final global crisis.

title: Historia Reiss
summary: Cadet whose plain kindness is backed by a claim to the throne itself.
bio: Born as an illegitimate child of Rod Reiss, she discarded her false Krista persona during the Uprising. Defying her father, she helped slay his Titan and was crowned the rightful monarch of Paradis.

title: Grisha Yeager
summary: Doctor who spent years abroad pressing a dangerous case.
bio: An Eldian doctor who led the Restorationists in Marley. On Paradis, he started a family, took the Founding Titan from the royal family, and sacrificed himself to pass his Titans to Eren.

title: Zeke Yeager
summary: Marley's Warrior Warchief and royal-blooded wielder of the Beast Titan.
bio: Son of Grisha and Dina Fritz, Zeke betrayed his parents to survive. As Beast Titan, his royal blood allows him to command Titans. He secretly orchestrates an Eldian euthanasia plan with Eren.

title: Ymir
summary: Quiet 104th survivor who protects a certain member of the royal family at any cost.
bio: A former vagrant falsely worshipped as a cult goddess in Marley, turned into a Pure Titan for decades. After eating Marcel and regaining humanity, she dedicated herself to protecting Historia.

title: Jean Kirstein
summary: Wants the Military Police for a safe life; something else keeps pulling him toward the front line.
bio: Initially aiming for a comfortable life in the Military Police, Marco's death inspired him to join the Scouts instead. He grew into a reliable battlefield commander with acute situational judgment.

title: Connie Springer
summary: Energetic Scout driven by grief over his Titan-transformed home village.
bio: An outgoing 104th graduate from Ragako village whose upbeat nature was tested when his family was turned into Titans. He remains a stalwart Scout committed to standing by his comrades in battle.

title: Sasha Blouse
summary: Talented hunter and sharpshooter known for her boundless love of food.
bio: A cheerful girl from Dauper with extraordinary hunting instincts and marksmanship. Famously stealing a potato on her first day, she proved to be a courageous and deadly Scout in major battles.

title: Falco Grice
summary: Kind Warrior candidate who would rather take a Titan than let someone else.
bio: A kind Eldian candidate in Marley fighting to protect Gabi from inheriting a Titan. After ingesting Zeke's spinal fluid, he transforms and inherits Porco's Jaw Titan, later manifesting wings.

title: Gabi Braun
summary: Fierce Warrior candidate whose extreme Marleyan indoctrination is challenged.
bio: Reiner's fiercely patriotic cousin and top Warrior candidate. After infiltrating Paradis and confronting the realities of island Eldians, she unlearns her hatred and aids the global alliance.

title: Pieck Finger
summary: Clever Marleyan Warrior who commands the versatile, long-endurance Cart Titan.
bio: An exceptionally observant Warrior whose Cart Titan provides long-distance reconnaissance, logistical transport, and mobile artillery support. She prioritizes the survival of her Eldian comrades.

title: Porco Galliard
summary: Hot-tempered Marleyan Warrior who inherited the Jaw Titan from Ymir.
bio: Marcel's younger brother who wields the agile Jaw Titan. Harboring resentment toward Reiner, he proves his bravery in battle before sacrificing himself to save Reiner and pass his Titan to Falco.

title: Founding Titan
summary: The progenitor of all Titans capable of controlling other Titans and human memories.
bio: The original Titan power that connects all Subjects of Ymir. It can manipulate memories, alter biology, command other Titans via the Coordinate, and initiate the Rumbling.

title: Attack Titan
summary: A fierce combat Titan that fights for freedom across generations.
bio: One of the Nine Titans, known for relentless brawling strength and the unique ability to perceive memories of both past and future inheritors, continuously striving for freedom.

title: Armored Titan
summary: A heavily armored juggernaut capable of breaching stone fortifications.
bio: Possesses thick plates of hardened skin covering almost its entire body, serving as a defensive tank and siege weapon that broke through Wall Maria's inner gate in 845.

title: Colossal Titan
summary: A 60-meter towering Titan that emits immense heat and explosive blasts.
bio: A colossal 60-meter Titan renowned for devastating explosive transformations, massive physical power, and the ability to release boiling steam to repel attackers.

title: Female Titan
summary: An agile, versatile Titan skilled in martial arts and localized hardening.
bio: An all-around combatant with exceptional mobility, endurance, crystal hardening, and a high-pitched scream that attracts Pure Titans. Piloted by Annie Leonhart.

title: Beast Titan
summary: A 17-meter ape-like Titan with deadly long-range throwing accuracy.
bio: A distinct 17-meter Titan with fur-covered skin and long arms. Inherited by Zeke Jaeger, its royal blood enables speech, precise long-range bombardment, and Titan creation.

title: Jaw Titan
summary: A small, rapid assault Titan with crushing jaws and hardened claws.
bio: A ferocious 5-meter quad-legged Titan known for supreme speed and hardened jaws that can crush Titan crystal and steel, held successively by Marcel, Ymir, Porco, and Falco.

title: Cart Titan
summary: A quadrupedal Titan boasting unmatched endurance and pack capability.
bio: A quadrupedal Titan with unrivaled stamina, able to stay transformed for months. It functions as mobile artillery, scout, and logistical support, operated by Pieck Finger.

title: War Hammer Titan
summary: A versatile Titan that constructs weapons and structures from hardened flesh.
bio: Possessed by the Tybur family, it creates diverse weaponry and spikes from hardened Titan flesh. Its pilot operates remotely from underground encased within an armored crystal.

title: Pure Titan
summary: Mindless man-eating giant humans roaming Paradis Island.
bio: Subjects of Ymir transformed into mindless cannibalistic giants by Titan spinal fluid. Ranging from 3 to 15 meters, they seek out humans instinctively without cognitive awareness.

title: Wall Titans
summary: Colossal-scale Titans standing dormant inside the stone of the three Walls.
bio: Countless Colossal-like Titans encased inside Walls Maria, Rose, and Sheena via hardening by King Karl Fritz, later unleashed by Eren Jaeger to trample the world in the Rumbling.

title: The Paths
summary: Ethereal metaphysical realm connecting all Subjects of Ymir and Titans.
bio: A timeless dimension existing beyond physical space where all Subjects of Ymir are linked via intangible paths to the Coordinate, channeling memories, wills, and Titan flesh.

title: Subjects of Ymir
summary: Ethnic group descended from Ymir Fritz capable of turning into Titans.
bio: Descendants of the progenitor Ymir Fritz biologically connected to the Paths, enabling them to transform into Titans upon spinal fluid injection or through the Founding Titan.

title: Royal Blood
summary: True royal lineage capable of unlocking the Founding Titan's full power.
bio: The royal bloodline descending directly from Ymir and King Fritz; only royal shifters or royals touching the Founder can command the Coordinate and bypass natural power limits.

title: Vow Renouncing War
summary: Pacifist ideological pact forced onto royal wielders of the Founding Titan.
bio: A psychological seal created by the 145th King, Karl Fritz, that indoctrinates royal inheritors of the Founding Titan to accept Eldia's demise and refuse offensive warfare.

title: The Rumbling
summary: Cataclysmic threat to unleash the Wall Titans to march across and flatten the earth.
bio: A cataclysmic defensive threat and eventual offensive event where the millions of Colossal Titans dormant within Paradis' walls are unleashed to flatten all land outside the island.

title: Coordinate
summary: Sought-after nexus power allowing its wielder to command all Titans at will.
bio: The nexus within the Paths embodied by the Founding Titan, granting the wielder absolute mental and physical control over all Subjects of Ymir and Pure Titans.

title: Titan inheritance
summary: Transfer of a Titan power by consuming a Titan shifter's spinal fluid.
bio: The biological succession mechanism where a Pure Titan eats an intelligent Titan shifter, absorbing their spinal fluid and power, but subjecting the inheritor to the 13-year Curse of Ymir.

title: Memory manipulation
summary: Royal power used to alter or erase humanity's memories inside the Walls.
bio: The psionic power of the Founding Titan to rewrite or erase the collective memories of Subjects of Ymir, used by Karl Fritz to make Paradis' citizens forget world history.

title: Eldian internment
summary: Segregation of Eldians into walled zones like Liberio under Marleyan rule.
bio: State-enforced racial segregation forcing Eldians into heavily guarded ghettos across Marley, requiring armband identification and serving as a labor and military conscription pool.

title: Great Titan War
summary: Civil war among the eight Titan houses that caused Eldia's collapse.
bio: A devastating historical conflict among Eldia's aristocratic Titan houses that Marley exploited alongside the Tybur family, resulting in the fall of the Eldian Empire roughly a century ago.

title: Paradise Island isolation
summary: Century-long seclusion of Eldians behind the Three Walls on Paradis.
bio: Karl Fritz's policy of withdrawing Eldians to Paradis Island, building Walls Maria, Rose, and Sheena, erasing memories, and enforcing a century of false peace in isolation.

title: Warrior program
summary: Marleyan military program recruiting Eldian youths as Titan shifters.
bio: A militarized selection initiative training young Eldians in Liberio to inherit Marley's Six Titans, offering honorary Marleyan citizenship to their families as incentive.

title: Shiganshina
summary: Southern gateway district of Wall Maria; childhood hometown of Eren Yeager.
bio: A protruding southern district of Wall Maria. It fell in 845 during the initial Colossal Titan attack, was recaptured during the Battle of Shiganshina, and later served as the launch of the Rumbling.

title: Trost District
summary: Southern gateway of Wall Rose defending humanity's interior.
bio: A protruding southern border town of Wall Rose. Breached by the Colossal Titan in 850, it became the battleground where Eren sealed the hole with a massive boulder, scoring humanity's first victory.

title: Wall Maria
summary: The outermost defensive wall enclosing humanity's largest territory.
bio: The outermost of the three concentric walls on Paradis Island. Measuring 50 meters in height, it protected agricultural lands until breached in 845, driving all surviving humans behind Wall Rose.

title: Wall Rose
summary: The middle defensive wall that served as humanity's frontline after 845.
bio: The second concentric barrier protecting human settlements. Following Wall Maria's tragic fall, it served as humanity's primary defense line until Maria was successfully reclaimed five years later.

title: Wall Sheena
summary: The innermost defensive wall protecting the royal crown, nobles, and elites.
bio: The innermost defensive wall safeguarding the Royal Government, wealthy elites, and Military Police. Secretly contains dormant Colossal Titans within its masonry, a truth guarded by the Wall Cult.

title: Mitras
summary: The fortified royal capital city situated at the center of Wall Sheena.
bio: The luxurious capital city of Paradis where the monarch, nobles, and Interior Police held power. It became the political focal point during the Scout Regiment's bloodless revolution against the crown.

title: Stohess District
summary: Eastern gateway district of Wall Sheena; site of the Female Titan's capture.
bio: An affluent district on Wall Sheena's eastern edge. It suffered immense structural destruction during the decisive urban confrontation between Eren Yeager and Annie Leonhart's Female Titan in 850.

title: Marley
summary: Militaristic continental empire utilizing Eldians as living Titan weapons.
bio: A dominant overseas superpower that conquered nations using stolen Titan powers while keeping Eldians subjugated in ghettos. Its desire for Paradis's natural resources drove the entire conflict.

title: Liberio
summary: Marleyan coastal city housing the internment zone for segregated Eldians.
bio: A major Marleyan coastal metropolis with a walled internment zone for Eldians. Home to Warrior candidates and the target of Eren's devastating surprise raid during Willy Tybur's festival speech.

title: Paradis Island
summary: Isolated island haven where the First King founded Eldia's walled refuge.
bio: A massive island containing the Three Walls, vast forest reserves, and valuable underground iceburst stones. It served as humanity's refuge for a century before becoming ground zero for world war.

title: Reiss Chapel
summary: Rural chapel concealing a glowing subterranean cavern for royal rituals.
bio: A remote stone chapel hiding an underground cavern of glowing Titan crystal where royal succession rituals occurred, Grisha stole the Founder, and Rod Reiss underwent his grotesque transformation.

title: Ragako Village
summary: Connie Springer's rural village in the southern sector of Wall Rose.
bio: A peaceful farming village in Wall Rose whose entire population, including Connie Springer's mother and father, was turned into Pure Titans via Zeke Yeager's inhaled spinal fluid gas in year 850.

title: Fort Salta
summary: Mountainous Marleyan fortress and airfield; site of the final battle.
bio: A mountaintop military base and airship depot in southern Marley. It served as the last refuge for fleeing continental refugees and the stage for the climactic Battle of Heaven and Earth against Eren.

title: Assault on Fort Slava
summary: Marleyan ground forces and Eldian warrior candidates assault the Mid-East Allied Forces stronghold at Fort Slava.

title: Destruction of the Mid-East Naval Fleet
summary: The Beast Titan and Armored Titan destroy the Mid-East naval fleet in the bay to seal victory.
because: Fort Slava artillery has been neutralized allowing the Titans to attack the warships directly.

title: Warriors Return to Liberio
summary: The Eldian warrior candidates and Titan shifters return by train to their families in the Liberio Internment Zone.
because: The victory at Fort Slava concludes the war and grants the troops temporary leave.

title: Conference Between Willy Tybur and Magath
summary: Willy Tybur meets Commander Magath to plan a global theatrical event in Liberio.

title: Falco Befriends a Wounded Soldier
summary: Falco speaks with an injured Eldian veteran named Kruger resting at the local hospital.

title: Delivery of Letters from the Hospital
summary: Falco secretly deposits letters into an external mailbox on behalf of the wounded soldier Kruger.
because: Kruger claims he wishes to send messages to his family without hospital censorship.

title: Falco Guides Reiner to a Basement
summary: Falco leads Reiner Braun away from the festival crowd into a secluded basement beneath a residential building.
because: Falco believes his wounded soldier acquaintance has an important private message for Reiner.

title: Confrontation Beneath the Stage
summary: Reiner discovers that the wounded soldier in the basement is Eren Yeager.
because: Eren has infiltrated Liberio and summoned Reiner prior to the international festival speech.

title: Willy Tybur's Address at the Festival
summary: Willy Tybur reveals the history of King Fritz and proclaims war against the island of Paradis.
because: Marley seeks an international coalition to eliminate the threat posed by Paradis Island.

title: Transformation in the Liberio Plaza
summary: The Attack Titan bursts through the building behind the stage and attacks Willy Tybur.
because: Eren launches a preemptive assault at the conclusion of Willy Tybur's declaration.

title: The Tybur Titan Enters the Battle
summary: Lara Tybur transforms into the War Hammer Titan to battle the Attack Titan in Liberio.
because: Willy Tybur's demise forces the Tybur family to deploy their hidden military asset.

title: Survey Corps Deploys in Liberio
summary: Mikasa Ackerman and the Survey Corps arrive equipped with anti-personnel gear to support Eren.
because: The Scouts carry out an extraction operation to rescue Eren and eliminate Marleyan leadership.

title: Colossal Titan Destroys the Port Fleet
summary: Armin Arlert transforms into the Colossal Titan in Liberio harbor and annihilates the Marleyan navy.
because: The Scouts must eliminate Marleyan naval reinforcements and secure the escape vector.

title: Breaching the War Hammer Crystal
summary: Eren uses the jaws of the subdued Jaw Titan to crush the crystal containing Lara Tybur.
because: Conventional titan strikes cannot penetrate the hardened crystal encasing the War Hammer's body.

title: Survey Corps Boards the Escape Airship
summary: The Survey Corps completes their offensive and retreats aboard an airship piloted by Onyankopon.
because: Their primary tactical objectives in Liberio have been achieved.

title: Warrior Candidates Infiltrate the Airship
summary: Gabi Braun and Falco Grice ascend into the departing airship using a tether and shoot Sasha Braus.
because: Gabi seeks vengeance for the destruction of Liberio and the deaths of her friends.

title: Discovery of Zeke in the Airship Cabin
summary: The captured warrior candidates discover that Zeke is alive and collaborating with Paradis.
because: Zeke faked his death in Liberio to defect to the island alongside Eren and the Scouts.

title: Airship Lands on Paradis Island
summary: The airship touches down on Paradis Island where Eren is immediately placed under arrest by the military.
because: The military command views Eren's unsanctioned Liberio strike as treasonous insubordination.

title: Arrival of the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers
summary: Armin recalls how Yelena and the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers first arrived on the island three years earlier.

title: Hizuru Delegation Visits Paradis
summary: Kiyomi Azumabito presents Zeke's three-part proposal to Paradis military leaders during diplomatic talks.

title: Escape from the Military Stockade
summary: Gabi and Falco deceive their guard to escape detention and flee into the Paradis countryside.
because: The young candidates refuse to remain captive on the island and seek a way back to Marley.

title: Arrival at the Braus Stables
summary: A local girl named Kaya finds Gabi and Falco by the river and invites them to stay at the Braus family farm.
because: Kaya assumes the two runaways are impoverished orphans in need of food and shelter.

title: Bombing of the Premier's Office
summary: An explosive device detonates inside Premier Dhalis Zachary's headquarters, assassinating him.
because: Rogue military dissidents despise the high command's decision to imprison and replace Eren.

title: Formation of the Yeagerist Faction
summary: Eren escapes confinement using the War Hammer's powers and unites with Floch Forster's rebellious faction.
because: The defectors intend to unite Eren and Zeke to activate the Rumbling independently of military orders.

title: Confrontation at the Restaurant
summary: Nicolo attacks Falco and Gabi with a wine bottle after discovering that Gabi killed Sasha.
because: Nicolo loved Sasha and is overwhelmed by grief upon confronting her killer.

title: Revelation of the Tainted Wine
summary: Nicolo warns the Scouts that the Marleyan wine served to the military high command contains Zeke's spinal fluid.
because: Falco accidentally swallowed a mouthful of the spilled wine during the altercation.

title: Eren Confronts Armin and Mikasa
summary: Eren verbally berates Mikasa and engages Armin in a violent fistfight at the restaurant.
because: Eren claims Mikasa is bound by Ackerman instincts and Armin is manipulated by Bertholdt's memories.

title: Transformation in the Giant Forest
summary: Zeke unleashes a scream that transforms Levi's thirty Scout escorts into Pure Titans.
because: The Scout guards had consumed the tainted Marleyan wine distributed to the forest camp.

title: Subjugation in the Giant Forest
summary: Captain Levi slaughters his transformed comrades, pursues Zeke, and eviscerates the Beast Titan.
because: Levi refuses to let Zeke escape to rendez-vous with Eren and the Yeagerists.

title: Zeke's Recollection of Liberio
summary: A dying Zeke remembers his childhood under Grisha and Dina and his mentorship under Tom Ksaver.

title: Detonation in the Wagon
summary: Zeke intentionally triggers the live Thunder Spear embedded in his torso, blowing himself and Levi apart.
because: Zeke gambles his survival to break free from Levi's torturous confinement.

title: Pieck Infiltrates Shiganshina Headquarters
summary: Pieck Finger pretends to surrender to Eren before tricking him onto the fortress rooftop.
because: Pieck aims to lure Eren into an exposed position for an ambush by Marleyan forces.

title: Marley Airships Descend on Shiganshina
summary: General Magath leads a surprise Marleyan airborne fleet that descends directly over Shiganshina.
because: Marley launches an immediate retaliatory strike to reclaim the Founding Titan before Eren can activate its power.
